children: Vernal Capital Acquisition Corp. reported a net profit for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, posting net income of $612215 and diluted earnings per share of $0.05, compared with a loss of $4193 and $(0.00) per share in the year‑ago quarter.
Net income was $612,215 for the three months ended July 31, 2026, versus ($4,193) in the year‑ago quarter (net swing to profit).
Diluted earnings per share was $0.05 for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (basic and diluted), versus $(0.00) in the year‑ago quarter.
Net income for the six months ended July 31, 2026 was $586,700, driven by interest income; the company reported no operating revenue.
Vernal Capital is a blank‑check company formed to identify and complete an initial business combination across industries and geographies.
The company's IPO and private placement raised $102.5M, with $100.5M placed in trust to fund a future business combination.
Post‑IPO activity to date has been limited to target identification, evaluation and administrative costs; the company has not reported operating revenues.
Management expects ongoing costs as it pursues a deal and notes substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue as a going concern without completing a timely business combination.
The company must complete a business combination by August 7, 2027 (unless extended) or face automatic liquidation.
